# cmidi-core

**Conversational MIDI Protocol — encode multi-agent discourse as symbolic music.**

[![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/cmidi-core.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/cmidi-core)
[![docs.rs](https://docs.rs/cmidi-core/badge.svg)](https://docs.rs/cmidi-core)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

CMIDI maps conversational speech acts to musical pitch classes, paralinguistic features to MIDI continuous controllers, and agent identity to channels and instruments. The result is a tensor representation of conversation that is simultaneously **human-readable as music** and **machine-parseable as structured data**.

This is not a metaphor. Every valid CMIDI file is a valid Standard MIDI File (SMF Format 0).

## Quick Start

```rust
use cmidi_core::*;

// Create a debate session (4/4, 120 BPM, C-major key)
let mut conv = Conversation::debate("Sprint Retro");

// Register agents — each gets a MIDI channel and instrument
conv.add_agent(CMAgent::new("alice", 0, AgentRole::Researcher)); // Oboe
conv.add_agent(CMAgent::new("bob",   1, AgentRole::Critic));     // Trumpet

// Agents speak — each speech act maps to a pitch
conv.speak(0,   0, SpeechAct::Assertion,  100, 480);  // alice: C4
conv.speak(480, 1, SpeechAct::Objection,  120, 960);  // bob:   G4
conv.speak(960, 0, SpeechAct::Agreement,   80, 480);  // alice: F4

// Analyze the conversation
let analysis = conv.analyze();
println!("Dominant speech act: {:?}", analysis.dominant_key);
println!("Peak tension at tick: {}", analysis.peak_tension_tick);
println!("Tension curve: {:?}", analysis.tension_curve);

// Export as standard MIDI bytes
let midi_bytes = conv.to_midi_bytes();
std::fs::write("sprint_retro.mid", &midi_bytes).unwrap();

// Parse MIDI bytes back into a Conversation
let restored = Conversation::from_midi_bytes(&midi_bytes).unwrap();
assert_eq!(restored.events.len(), 3);
```

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Conversation                        │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐             │
│  │  Agents   │  │  Events  │  │ FakeBook │             │
│  │ (ch 0-15) │  │ (sorted) │  │ (charts) │             │
│  └────┬─────┘  └────┬─────┘  └──────────┘             │
│       │              │                                  │
│  ┌────▼─────┐  ┌────▼──────────────────────┐           │
│  │ AgentRole │  │ SpeechAct + CC + Velocity  │          │
│  │ (instr.)  │  │ (pitch)  (nuance) (conf)   │          │
│  └──────────┘  └────────────────────────────┘           │
│       │              │                                  │
│       ▼              ▼                                  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐                │
│  │        MIDI Bytes (SMF Format 0)    │                │
│  │  MThd → MTrk → tempo → program →   │                │
│  │  CC → Note On → Note Off → EOT      │                │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────┘                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Speech Act → Note Mapping

| Speech Act   | Note | Interval from C | Semantics                  |
|-------------|------|-----------------|----------------------------|
| `Assertion`  | C4   | unison          | Ground truth, factual claim |
| `Question`   | D4   | M2              | Inquiry, opening           |
| `Command`    | E4   | M3              | Directive, instruction     |
| `Agreement`  | F4   | P4              | Harmonization              |
| `Objection`  | G4   | P5              | Dissonance, disagreement   |
| `Elaboration`| A4   | M6              | Development, extension     |
| `Transition` | B4   | M7              | Modulation, topic shift    |
| `Silence`    | Rest | —               | Strategic listening        |

Two speech acts are **consonant** when their interval is a traditional consonance (unison, m3, M3, P4, P5, m6, octave). This models conversational harmony: agreement + assertion = stable chord; objection + transition may introduce productive tension.

## CC Mapping (Paralinguistic Features)

| CC# | Name              | Range Semantics                          |
|-----|-------------------|------------------------------------------|
| 1   | Engagement        | 0 = disengaged, 127 = flow state         |
| 2   | Sarcasm           | 0 = sincere, 127 = maximum irony         |
| 7   | Salience          | Volume — importance weight               |
| 10  | Sentiment         | 0 = objecting, 127 = endorsing           |
| 11  | Nuance            | Subtext depth                            |
| 16  | Expertise         | Domain specialization                    |
| 17  | Urgency           | Time pressure                            |
| 18  | ReferenceDepth    | How deeply sourced                       |
| 19  | Novelty           | How new / original                       |
| 102 | Tension           | Conversational dissonance                |
| 103 | VoiceLeading      | Semantic transition smoothness           |
| 104 | ConservationRatio | CR from tensor-MIDI representation       |

## Agent Role → Instrument

| Role        | GM# | Instrument        | Personality           |
|-------------|-----|-------------------|-----------------------|
| Researcher  | 68  | Oboe              | Inquisitive, piercing |
| Builder     | 42  | Cello             | Foundational, harmonic|
| Critic      | 56  | Trumpet           | Sharp, cutting        |
| Integrator  | 0   | Piano             | Connecting, voicing   |
| Explorer    | 65  | Alto Sax          | Improvisational       |
| Conductor   | 48  | String Ensemble   | Holds it together     |
| Guardian    | 47  | Timpani           | Sentinel, boundary    |
| Narrator    | 52  | Choir             | Storytelling          |

## API Highlights

### Conversation Presets

```rust
let debate = Conversation::debate("Topic");       // 4/4, 120 BPM
let explore = Conversation::exploration("What if"); // 7/8, 90 BPM
let fight = Conversation::adversarial("Versus");  // 4/4, 160 BPM
```

### Analysis

```rust
let analysis = conversation.analyze();
// tension_curve: Vec<f64>          — sampled at each beat
// speech_act_histogram: HashMap    — counts per act
// dominant_key: SpeechAct          — most used act
// peak_tension_tick: u32           — when tension peaks
```

### Merge & Filter

```rust
let combined = conv_a.merge(&conv_b);
let alice_only = conv.filter_by_agent(0);
```

### Transpose

```rust
let higher = conv.transpose(7);  // up a fifth
```

### Round-trip MIDI I/O

```rust
let bytes = conv.to_midi_bytes();
let restored = Conversation::from_midi_bytes(&bytes)?;
```

### Serde (feature-gated)

```rust
// Enabled by default. Disable in Cargo.toml:
// cmidi-core = { version = "0.2", default-features = false }
let json = serde_json::to_string(&conv).unwrap();
```

## Feature Flags

| Flag     | Default | Description                              |
|----------|---------|------------------------------------------|
| `serde`  | ✓       | `Serialize`/`Deserialize` for all types  |
